latest.title: Excel Grid Selection, Query Latency Fix & Toolbar Auto-Update
latest.summary: Excel-grade spreadsheet selection UI with column/row select and fill handles, connection pool keepalive tuning to fix query stalls, pinned result refresh, and in-toolbar glowing auto-update and restart.

highlights.title: Excel-Grade Grid Selection
highlights.description: Full column header selection, row number selection, 1x1 cell Cmd+C copy, rounded corners, and corner fill-handle indicator.

highlights.title: Database Query Performance
highlights.description: Fixed query latency by configuring persistent pool constraints, TCP keepalive, and throttled background schema fetching.

highlights.title: Pinned Result Refresh
highlights.description: Added instant query re-execution and data refresh for pinned tabs directly from tab pills and toolbar.

highlights.title: In-Toolbar Auto-Update & Restart
highlights.description: Glowing update button appears side-by-side with Run button when an update is available, with one-click install and restart.
